description: stdio/v1 — GENERIC leaf worker: lets an external program (any language, no converge Go SDK) act as a converge resource. bin/stdworker runs the program configured for the kind (providerconfig.command/args, or the STDIO_COMMAND env var), pipes the task in as one JSON Request on stdin (reaction, spec, config, bundle), and reads one JSON Response on stdout (status, conditions) — the converge stdio protocol. exit 0 = success, exit 2 = terminal (no retry), other non-zero = transient (retried); stderr is captured. Spec and config are OPAQUE — the program owns their schema. The classic case is 'run some arbitrary bash and record the result'. See examples/demos/stdio/testfixtures/handler.sh for the canonical stdio-RPC implementation.

spec_schema.description: OPAQUE — forwarded to the program verbatim as request.spec. Shape is whatever the program understands.

config_schema.description: Launch settings for the stdio provider (plus an opaque `settings` blob forwarded to the program as request.config).

command.description: Program to run per task (path or PATH name). Falls back to the STDIO_COMMAND env var.

args.description: Fixed leading arguments passed to the command on every task.

env.description: Extra environment variables (KEY→VALUE) for the child process.

settings.description: Opaque configuration forwarded to the program as request.config.

timeout_seconds.description: Per-task subprocess timeout in seconds (0 = none; the task deadline still applies).

status_schema.description: OPAQUE — whatever the program writes as response.status.
